annotations.text:
The Moon, rebuilt.
Real near-side maria (Imbrium, Serenitatis, Tranquillitatis, Crisium, Procellarum) in their true relative positions, Tycho's ray system, limb darkening, a soft terminator and earthshine on the unlit edge. Grain is an SVG turbulence filter, so it stays sharp at any size and needs no image file.

Star info.
A bright star is a point source, so it is drawn as one: core, chromatic halo, diffraction spikes — in Betelgeuse's real catalogue tint. The panel now answers where it is (its place in Orion), how bright, what colour and how far, instead of name + one line.

Background.
A textured Milky Way with a galactic bulge and dark dust lanes, airglow above the horizon, and stars in three depth tiers. The three shooting stars run on unequal 17s / 23s / 31s cycles and are visible for only a sliver of each, so they never fall into a rhythm.

Controls.
Every target goes to 44-52px (play and zoom are 38px today, under the floor, on an app a three-year-old drives with a fingertip). One clear primary per surface, a real pressed state on everything, and Explore's two stacked bars folded into one.
